<thought>Using the most intense peak at m/z 182.073165 from the ESI spectrum, the ion corresponds to the molecular ion (no adduct). The exact mass matches the calculated monoisotopic mass of C₁₃H₁₀O (13 × 12.0000 + 10 × 1.007825 + 15.994915 = 182.073165 Da). This formula gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 9), confirming its plausibility.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O</final_answer>
